items.title: adn.de
items.snippet: Here are 10 top real Value Added Distributors (VADs) operating in Germany (DE) that match your search criteria for networking, enterprise WLAN, LAN, and IT channel partner enablement: 1. **ADN – Advanced Digital Network Distribution GmbH** * **URL:** [adn.de](https://www.adn.de) * **Why it matches:** Leading German VAD that supplies specialized networking (LAN/WLAN) and cloud management solutions (e.g., TP-Link Omada, enterprise network infrastructure) to system houses, MSPs, and resellers. 2. **sysob IT-Distribution GmbH** * **URL:** [sysob.de](https://www.sysob.de) * **Why it matches:** Independent owner-managed VAD based in Germany focused on enterprise network infrastructure, IT security, and wireless LAN solutions (distributing vendors such as Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise LAN/WLAN). 3. **Infinigate Deutschland GmbH** * **URL:** [infinigate.de](https://www.infinigate.de) * **Why it matches:** Premier VAD operating across DACH; specializes in IT security and enterprise WLAN/LAN infrastructure (partnering with vendors like Ruckus, Aruba/HPE, and Ekahau Wi-Fi survey systems). 4. **Westcon-Comstor Germany (Westcon Group Germany GmbH)** * **URL:** [westconcomstor.com](https://www.westconcomstor.com) * **Why it matches:** Global VAD with a strong local German presence, providing high-end enterprise switching, LAN, Wi-Fi, and private wireless network hardware to channel partners. 5. **Kappa Data Deutschland GmbH** * **URL:** [kappadata.de](https://www.kappadata.de) * **Why it matches:** Dedicated VAD in Europe (with local German operations) specializing in LAN, enterprise WLAN (e.g., LANCOM Systems), network security, and channel sales training. 6. **ALLNET GmbH Computersysteme** * **URL:** [allnet.de](https://www.allnet.de) * **Why it matches:** German value-added distributor and manufacturer known for its specialized portfolio in networking technology (*Netzwerktechnik*), professional WLAN access points, switches, and active LAN
